purpose: A truth-aware, pre-K1 capacity diagnostic for a physically distinct local transport object after v118 BP-difference and v119.1 residual transport were closed.
scope: already-open v111 PoolFire proxy bundles only; known geometry; noiseless straight-ray proxy; no deployment, call-reduction, wall/RSS, external, neural, or real-BOST claim

deployment_visible_construction.motion_source: presealed v117 local phase shifts; accepted exactly when integer shift is nonzero and relative coherence improvement exceeds 1e-12
deployment_visible_construction.formula: start from q8_current; for each accepted fixed block replace only that block by zero_fill_shift(q8_previous, v117_shift); all other blocks remain q8_current

truth_aware_question: Across every signal-bearing frozen frame-context, does transported previous q8 reduce initial full-field relative-L2 error versus direct current q8 often enough to establish pre-K1 representation headroom?
roster: v111 five trajectories x three geometries x six held-out coordinate maps x frozen frames; frame 0 cannot be signal-bearing because it has no predecessor
failure_action: If the capacity gate fails, close simple blockwise previous-q8 replacement under the frozen v117 motion cue. Do not rescue it with a neural network or a new blend search.
pass_action: A pass authorizes only a separately frozen deployment-visible candidate and full eight-gate score. It does not authorize training, resource claims, external generalization, or real-BOST claims.
claim_boundary: Truth is decoded only after v117 motion input and the validated v111 bundle barrier are verified. This is not a deployable warm start and algorithm_breakthrough remains false.
